original_source_package.policy: The original release ZIP bytes are preserved in the previous reviewed source package, outside this English export. Adapted archives in this export are not byte-identical original releases.

adaptation_policy: Translate Persian Markdown/TXT documents, rename their filenames with EN suffixes, update direct human-readable links, replace Persian path fixture words with explicit Unicode escapes, and translate one generated README literal. All other members are byte unchanged. Original historical checksum files remain dated attestations of original releases, not hashes of these adapted copies. Current export bytes are recorded in ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.json.
unchanged_data_policy: All fixed-S0 inputs, JSON/JSONL captures and results, CSV/TSV labels and logs, Excel submissions, source XML, PDF files, production runtime modules, and exact-triple scorer bytes are unchanged. No new inference, API requests, semantic evaluation, or experiment was performed.
